--- title: "How to convert from pandas to polars dataframe" subtitle: "pl.from_pandas" author: '{{< var author >}}' date: '2025-07-03' date-format: iso toc: true toc-title: 'Sections' toc-location: right toc-depth: 3 categories: [100DaysOfPolars] --- Polars is highly versatile. It can accept a Pandas dataframe and convert it into a Polars dataframe. This conversion is especially useful when working with HTML data, as Polars currently does not support reading directly from HTML. ## Reading HTML data with pandas Yes, it’s possible to read HTML tables using Pandas, just as you would read data from a CSV file. ::: {#4c5f4a60 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import pandas as pd url = 'https://rstudio-pubs-static.s3.amazonaws.com/383830_4aef25cdc42f4fd88d09cc8217b8924c.html' df = pd.read_html(url)[0] df ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ```{=html}
observation beantype cocoapercent rating
0 1 Forastero (Arriba) 0.55 2.75
1 2 Forastero (Arriba) 0.70 3.00
2 3 Forastero 0.75 2.75
3 4 Forastero (Nacional) 0.70 3.50
4 5 Criollo, Trinitario 0.70 3.50
5 6 Forastero 0.70 3.50
``` ::: ::: ## Change from pandas to polars dataframe The `pl.from_pandas` expression allows us to turn a Pandas dataframe to a polars dataframe. Here's how to use it. ::: {#80a9b0b0 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} import polars as pl pl.from_pandas(df) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ```{=html}
